text: The Patriots edge rush trio of Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas has been a legitimate bright spot through four games, but the defense faces a stiff test in Week 5 against Kirk Cousins and the surprisingly hot 3-1 Raiders, with Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis remaining sidelined by injuries while the running back situation remains murky despite Rhamondre Stevenson's return to practice. On the brighter side, the Patriots signed safety Mike Brown to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and linebacker Jose Ramirez to the practice squad, providing some depth reinforcements for the 2-2 home team heading into Gillette. As if the uniforms weren't throwback enough for Week 5—the Patriots will indeed be wearing their classic look while the Packers debut their Rivalries uniform—a new JetBlue Loft at Gillette, featuring 15,000 square feet of premium hospitality space, has been unveiled to enhance the gameday experience.
